name: Gigabit Multi-WAN VPN Routers (GWN700x)
source_note: Grandstream's GWN700x wired Multi-WAN VPN router series (GWN7001/GWN7002/GWN7003): 2.2 Gbps NAT routing, 530 Mbps IPsec VPN, embedded controller for 100-150 GWN APs. Lowest routing and VPN throughput of the Grandstream gateways in this catalog. Ranking is team-derived from published throughput, not a Grandstream-published ladder.

name: 2.5G Convergence Gateways (GCC601x)
source_note: Grandstream GCC6010 Series UC + Networking Convergence devices (VPN router + NGFW + IP PBX + switch). Published 2.5 Gbps routing, 1 Gbps IPsec VPN, 900 Mbps IDS/IPS, 160K NAT sessions; first Grandstream gateway tier with a published IDS/IPS figure. Ranked above GWN700x on routing, VPN and security throughput. Team-derived, not a Grandstream-published ladder.

name: 10G Convergence Gateways (GCC602x)
source_note: Grandstream GCC6020 Series UC + Networking Convergence devices with 10G SFP+. Published 6.5-10 Gbps routing, 1.3 Gbps IPsec VPN, 6-9 Gbps NGFW (DPI+IPS), 320K NAT sessions. Highest-throughput Grandstream gateways in this catalog. Team-derived, not a Grandstream-published ladder.

name: L2 Lite Managed (GWN771x)
source_note: Grandstream markets the GWN7711(P)/GWN7712P/GWN7713P as Layer 2 Lite managed switches with Gigabit copper and 1G SFP uplinks; the entry managed tier by Grandstream's own L2 Lite / L2+ / L3 / L3 Aggregation series naming.

name: L2 Lite Managed Multi-Gigabit (GWN7721)
source_note: Grandstream markets the GWN7721 Series as Layer 2 Lite managed, the same management tier as GWN771x, but with 2.5GbE copper and 10G SFP+ uplinks (80 Gbps switching). Splitting it above GWN771x and below the L2+ GWN780x series is the team's judgment so the High-Performance step from an L2 Lite pick stays within the L2 Lite tier first.

name: L2+ Managed (GWN780x)
source_note: Grandstream markets the GWN7801(P)/GWN7802(P)/GWN7803(P)/GWN7806(P) as Enterprise Layer 2+ managed switches, following Grandstream's L2 Lite / L2+ / L3 / L3 Aggregation series tiering.

name: L3 Managed (GWN781x)
source_note: Grandstream markets the GWN7811(P)/GWN7812P/GWN7813(P)/GWN7816(P) as Layer 3 managed switches with 10G SFP+ uplinks and static/dynamic routing, following Grandstream's L2 Lite / L2+ / L3 / L3 Aggregation series tiering.

name: L3 Aggregation (GWN783x)
source_note: Grandstream markets the GWN7830/GWN7831/GWN7832 as Layer 3 aggregation switches (fiber-dense, up to 12x 10G SFP+, up to 240 Gbps switching); top tier of Grandstream's switch series naming.
